name: roadmapper
description: Roadmapper draws a roadmap, kept in one JSON file, as a tree: zoomed out, anyone can read it, and zooming in shows more detail.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/roadmapper.mjs build
scripts.build:tests: node scripts/roadmapper.mjs build tests/roadmapper.json dist/tests/app && vite build tests/page --config tests/page/vite.config.ts && vite build tests/embed --config tests/embed/vite.config.ts && node scripts/roadmapper.mjs export tests/export/plan.json dist/tests/export
scripts.test: npm run build:lib && npm run build:cli && npm run build:tests && playwright test
scripts.build:lib: tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts --mode module && vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts --mode script && vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts --mode export && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json
scripts.package: npm run build:lib && npm run build:cli && node scripts/pack.mjs
scripts.prepack: npm run build:lib && npm run build:cli
scripts.export: npm run build:lib && node scripts/roadmapper.mjs export
